Earlier scenes:

This scene:
古代的时候，有一个人叫神农。一天，神农正在路上走，一看很多人正在吃一些植物。一些人一吃植物就生病了，神农想帮别人。所以想知道哪些植物能吃，哪些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 一看很多人正在吃一些植物：看到，一……就
- 神农想帮别人：帮他们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This expression is not used naturally for a general historical setting; use the fixed time-setting phrase “在古代”.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 一看很多人：一看到很多人，Use “看到” when the meaning is “see/notice.” “看” means “look,” while “看到” marks the result of seeing.
3. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 神农想帮别人。所以想知道：因为神农想帮别人，所以想知道，Use the paired connector “因为……所以……” to show the cause-and-effect relation between wanting to help people and wanting to learn which plants are safe.

items.reason: 古代的时候 is redundantly formed for this time setting; 在古代 is correct.
看到 is needed for noticing people, and the full original also needs the 一……就…… pattern.
别人 is wrong here because Shen Nong wants to help those people, so it should be 帮他们; the proposed correction leaves this error unchanged.
